# exo_remote_domain (Data Source)

Look up an existing RemoteDomain object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_oof_type` (String) Maps to the -AllowedOOFType parameter.

- `meeting_forward_notification_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -MeetingForwardNotificationEnabled parameter.
